_comment: Laptop side of the reactor: where the Raspberry Pi is. mode "simulator" = a Pi bridge with a virtual Arduino inside this server (no hardware; the page always shows СИМУЛЯТОР). mode "pi" = the real Pi at pi_url (direct Ethernet cable: http://192.168.50.2:8780, see docs/raspberry_setup.md). Environment overrides: BIOREACTOR_SENSORS=simulator|pi, BIOREACTOR_PI_URL=http://...
